title: fix(schema): add missing activation-nonce-mismatch to pre-merge-readiness claim.reason enum
body:
## Background

`schemas/pre-merge-readiness.schema.json`'s `claim.reason` property
declares:

```json
"enum": ["match", "missing-active-claim", "claim-id-mismatch", "agent-id-mismatch"]
```

`summarizeClaimValidation` in `src/scripts/protocol-helpers.mts` can
also set `reason` to a fifth value, `activation-nonce-mismatch`, when
both `expectedClaimId` and `expectedNonce` are supplied and the
trusted active-claim's activation-nonce winner does not match the
expected nonce (see the `else if (expectedClaimId && expectedNonce)`
branch, around line 5381). `idd-pre-merge.instructions.md`'s F2 gate
always passes `--nonce`, so this branch is reachable in production,
not merely theoretical.

Flagged by CodeRabbit during review of PR #1871 (Refs #1867), which
added `description` fields to this schema but could not fix the enum
itself: #1867's acceptance criteria are explicitly annotation-only —
"No schema property name, type, enum, pattern, required list,
additionalProperties rule, or emitted readiness field changes" — so
widening the enum is out of scope for that PR.

## Proposed change

Add `"activation-nonce-mismatch"` to `claim.reason`'s `enum` in
`schemas/pre-merge-readiness.schema.json`, keeping every other enum
value and the property's `description` unchanged.

## Acceptance criteria

- `claim.reason`'s enum includes `activation-nonce-mismatch` alongside
  the existing four values.
- No other property name, type, enum, pattern, required list, or
  additionalProperties rule in the schema changes.
- `node --test tests/schema-validation.test.mts
  tests/schema-type-reconciliation.test.mts
  tests/schema-output-roundtrip.test.mts` and
  `node scripts/validate-schemas.mjs` pass.
- A fixture or test exercises the `activation-nonce-mismatch` reason
  against the schema (a currently-missing case: the existing
  `fixtures/schemas/pre-merge-readiness.valid.json` /
  `.invalid.json` pair does not cover this value).

Refs #1867
